# A loop of components renders on win32: each copy a keyed `for` keeps is a
# component built at run time, which placement writes as a record -- a box
# struct of its vars and nodes, its constructor the body, its setters and
# teardown functions of the package taking it -- and a test reaches one copy
# through the package's map from each copy's key to its node, which the
# render that stamps the keys starts afresh, so a copy the render no longer
# makes is null.

env SNGL_UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=1
sngl test --platform=win32 --language=c app.sngl
stdout 'ok +2 tests, 0 failures'
exists app.sngl.snapshots/dropped.png

# A loop at the top of a component's body renders into the container the
# platform's #[gen.protocol(contents)] makes, which the component's other
# top nodes go into in the order written.

sngl test --platform=win32 --language=c top.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'

# Three controls a copy, an input's value an effect writes: the effect's
# mount reads the input its render slot made, which placement holds in a
# package var beside the slot's local, and each copy's handler still reads
# its own.

sngl test --platform=win32 --language=c rows.sngl
stdout 'ok +2 tests, 0 failures'

# A method of a nested component the test calls through its instance is
# handed no receiver: its state is the program's.

sngl test --platform=win32 --language=c nested.sngl
stdout 'ok +3 tests, 0 failures'

# A copy's own method, called from its view and from a var's initializer,
# is a function of the package's handed the record: the var it initializes
# is set once the record holds what the method reads.

sngl test --platform=win32 --language=c methods.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'

# A sngl:seq sequence held or passed is the list of what it counts, which is
# what C holds an iter[T] as; one a loop walks where it is written is counted
# and never built.

sngl test --platform=win32 --language=c seq.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'

# The same programs in Go, which calls the runtime through the wrappers
# `sngl tool cgogen` writes (lib/platform/win32/cgo) and serves its tests
# over TCP as C's agent does, draw what C's drew: each snapshot is held to
# the one the C run wrote.

env SNGL_UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=
sngl test --platform=win32 --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok +2 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=win32 --language=go top.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=win32 --language=go rows.sngl
stdout 'ok +2 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=win32 --language=go nested.sngl
stdout 'ok +3 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=win32 --language=go seq.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=win32 --language=go methods.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import test "sngl:test"

component main ui.node {
    var names = ["ann", "bob", "cy"]
    var picked = ""
    ui.vbox {
        for var name = names {
            ui.button #row(text=name, @click { picked = name })
        }
        ui.button #drop(text="Drop", @click { names = ["dee"] })
    }
}

ui.window {
    main()
}

func testAClickReachesItsCopy(t test.Test, c main) {
    c.row[1].click()
    t.assert(c.picked == "bob")
    c.row[2].click()
    t.assert(c.picked == "cy")
}

func testARenderReplacesTheCopies(t test.Test, c main) {
    t.assert(c.row[2] != null)
    c.drop.click()
    t.assert(c.row[1] == null)
    t.assert(c.row[2] == null)
    c.row[0].click()
    t.assert(c.picked == "dee")
    t.snapshot("dropped")
}

-- top.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

component main node {
    var seen = ""
    var xs = ["a", "b"]
    for var x = xs {
        button #pick(text=x, @click { seen = seen + x })
    }
}

func testClickInLoop(t Test, c main) {
    c.pick[1].click()
    c.pick[0].click()
    t.assert(c.seen == "ba")
}

-- rows.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

component main node {
    var items = ["a", "b"]
    var log = ""
    vbox {
        button #swap(text="swap", @click { items = ["c", "d", "e"] })
        for var it = items {
            button #tap(text=it, @click { log = it })
            checkbox #box(label=it, @change(on) { log = "{it} {on}" })
            input #field(value=it, @change(v) { log = "{it}={v}" })
        }
        text(value=log)
    }
}

func testOneCopy(t Test, c main) {
    c.tap[1].click()
    t.assert(c.log == "b")
    c.box[0].change(true)
    t.assert(c.log == "a true")
    c.field[1].change("x")
    t.assert(c.log == "b=x")
}

func testOneCopyAfterTheLoopRendersAgain(t Test, c main) {
    c.swap.click()
    c.tap[2].click()
    t.assert(c.log == "e")
    c.box[1].change(true)
    t.assert(c.log == "d true")
    c.field[0].change(value="y")
    t.assert(c.log == "c=y")
}

window {
    main
}

-- nested.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

component bar(label string) node {
    var hits = 0
    func reset() {
        hits = 0
    }
    vbox {
        button #btn(text=label, @click {
            hits = hits + 1
        })
        text #shown(value="{label}: {hits}")
        for var i = [1] {
            button #row(text="r{i}", @click {
                hits = hits + 10
            })
        }
    }
}

component main node {
    var greeting = "hello"
    vbox {
        bar #b(label="go")
        text #t(value=greeting)
    }
}

func testANestedComponentsStateAndNodes(t Test, c main) {
    c.b.btn.click()
    t.assert(c.b.hits == 1)
    t.assert(c.b.shown.value == "go: 1")
    c.b.reset()
    t.assert(c.b.hits == 0)
}

func testANodesOneWayProp(t Test, c main) {
    t.assert(c.t.value == "hello")
    c.greeting = "bye"
    t.assert(c.t.value == "bye")
    t.assert(c.b.label == "go")
}

func testOneCopyOfALoopInANestedComponent(t Test, c main) {
    c.b.row[0].click()
    t.assert(c.b.hits == 10)
}

window {
    main
}
-- seq.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import test "sngl:test"
import seq "sngl:seq"

func sum(xs iter[int]) int {
    var s = 0
    for var x = xs {
        s = s + x
    }
    return s
}

component main ui.node {
    var n = 5
    var log = ""
    ui.vbox {
        ui.button #go(text="go", @click {
            var evens = seq.step(0, n, 2)
            var down = seq.step(n, 0, -2)
            log = "{sum(evens)} {sum(down)} {sum(seq.count(n))} {sum(seq.range(2, n))} {sum([7, 8])}"
        })
    }
}

func testHeldAndPassed(t test.Test, c main) {
    c.go.click()
    t.assert(c.log == "6 9 10 9 15")
}

ui.window {
    main()
}
-- methods.sngl --
import test "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

component row(label string) ui.node {
    var base = "<"
    var shown = decorate()
    func decorate() string {
        return base
    }
    ui.button #b(text="{label}{decorate()}{shown}")
}

component main ui.node {
    var names = ["ann", "bob"]
    ui.vbox {
        for var name = names {
            row #r(label=name)
        }
    }
}

ui.window {
    main()
}

func testAMethodReadsItsCopy(t test.Test, c main) {
    t.assert(c.r[1].shown == "<")
}
